Featured Article

Pink Wave is a custom Hard Demon level created and verified by Maxr3 on Maxr3 GDPS. Featuring fast-paced mini-wave corridors and custom 2.2 camera triggers, it serves as a benchmark for high-CPS gameplay on the server.

sections.heading: About Maxr3 GDPS
sections.content: Maxr3 GDPS is a custom Geometry Dash Private Server operating on game version 2.208. The server focuses on custom level creation, active moderation, and competitive verification tracked through the official Maxr3 GDPS Demon List.

sections.heading: Wiki Changelog & Architecture
sections.content: Running on Wiki Engine {{WIKI_VERSION}}, all encyclopedia entries are stored as structured JSON schemas supporting standardized Infobox templates for levels, players, updates, and server guidelines.
